# Caplo

> Caplo is a platform for building, testing and publishing AI agents that talk to customers over a website widget, voice, phone and messaging channels. Agents are configured in the Caplo console or as YAML files with the `caplo` CLI, call tool packages (TypeScript functions or MCP servers) and remote MCP servers, search knowledge bases, and are published as immutable releases that channels serve.

- Every page is also available as Markdown: append `.md` to its URL without the trailing slash, for example https://docs.caplo.si/agents/publishing.md.
- JSON Schemas for agent files, tool package `caplo.yaml` and fixtures are at https://docs.caplo.si/schemas/.
- The CLI reference is generated from the released `caplo` binary; prefer it over guesses about flags.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://docs.caplo.si/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Caplo, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://docs.caplo.si/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Caplo
- [Build agents](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/build-agents.txt): agent configuration, knowledge, sub-agents, evals and publishing
- [Tools](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/tools.txt): writing, testing and publishing tool packages and remote MCP servers
- [CLI](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/cli.txt): installing and using the caplo CLI, with the full command reference
- [Channels](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/channels.txt): the website widget, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, phone channels and Chatwoot handoff
- [Customer identity](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/customer-identity.txt): verifying customers and letting tools act on their accounts
- [Workspace administration](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/workspace-administration.txt): members, SSO, API keys, secrets, provider keys, usage, the inbox and data settings
- [SDK](https://docs.caplo.si/_llms-txt/sdk.txt): the @caplo/tools API and tool package guides

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
